rows.ja: 競合(Manhattan Associatesの年次報告に記載)
rows.en: Competitors (named in Manhattan Associates' annual report)

companies.name: パナソニック ホールディングス

relations.text: 年次報告が、サプライチェーン実行・計画の競合としてBlue Yonder/Panasonic(旧JDA)を挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names Blue Yonder/Panasonic (formerly JDA) among supply chain execution and planning competitors

source.label: Manhattan Associates 10-K
source.quote: • Supply chain execution and planning vendors, including Blue Yonder/Panasonic (formerly JDA), E2Open, Infios (formerly Korber, HighJump), SAS Institute, the Sterling Commerce division of IBM, Relex, and others;
source.note: Blue Yonder/Panasonicとしての記載です。

relations.text: 年次報告が、競合としてIBMのSterling Commerce部門を挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names the Sterling Commerce division of IBM as a competitor

source.label: Manhattan Associates 10-K
source.quote: • Supply chain execution and planning vendors, including Blue Yonder/Panasonic (formerly JDA), E2Open, Infios (formerly Korber, HighJump), SAS Institute, the Sterling Commerce division of IBM, Relex, and others;
source.note: 部門レベルの記載です。

relations.text: Manhattan Associatesが、Google Cloudとの販売面の提携拡大を発表し、全Manhattan ActiveソリューションがGoogle Cloud Marketplaceで利用できるとした
relations.text_en: Manhattan announced an expanded go-to-market partnership with Google Cloud, with all Manhattan Active solutions available on Google Cloud Marketplace

source.label: Manhattan Associates の発表
source.quote: Manhattan Associates Inc. (NASDAQ: MANH), the global leader in supply chain commerce, today announced an expanded go-to-market (GTM) partnership with Google Cloud .

relations.text: Manhattan Associatesが、2025 Google Cloud Business Applications Partner of the Year Award(サプライチェーン・物流部門)を受賞した
relations.text_en: Manhattan announced it received the 2025 Google Cloud Business Applications Partner of the Year Award for Supply Chain and Logistics

source.label: Manhattan Associates の発表
source.quote: Manhattan Associates Inc. (NASDAQ: MANH) today announced that it has received the 2025 Google Cloud Business Applications Partner of the Year Award for Supply Chain and Logistics.

relations.text: Manhattanは、ハネウェルの音声ソリューションの専門性を評価し、パートナー賞の対象とした
relations.text_en: Manhattan recognized Honeywell in its partner awards for voice-solution expertise that helped Manhattan customers raise productivity

source.label: Manhattan Associates の発表
source.quote: Honeywell for their deep expertise in voice solutions, leading Manhattan customers to achieve record-breaking productivity while also improving accuracy.

relations.text: Manhattan Active Order ManagementのコネクターアプリがShopify App Storeで利用可能になった
relations.text_en: A connector app to Manhattan Active Order Management is now available in the Shopify App Store

source.label: Manhattan Associates の発表
source.quote: a connector app to Manhattan Active ® Order Management is now available in the Shopify App Store.

relations.text: 年次報告が、ERPベンダーの競合としてOracleを挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists Oracle among competing ERP vendors

source.label: Manhattan Associates 10-K
source.quote: ERP vendors, including: Oracle, SAP and Infor, among others;

relations.text: 年次報告が、ERPベンダーの競合としてSAPを挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists SAP among competing ERP vendors

source.label: Manhattan Associates 10-K
source.quote: ERP vendors, including: Oracle, SAP and Infor, among others;
